# Licences accepted for THIRD-PARTY dependencies (Python and npm) of NXERP. One SPDX identifier per line.
# Used by tools/check_licenses.py (CI job `license-check`). Anything not listed fails the job unless it has a reviewed
# entry in exceptions.txt. Names that tools print differently (e.g. "MIT License", "Apache Software License") are
# normalised by the script. This is an engineering policy, NOT legal advice: counsel must approve changes to it.
#
# WHY each group is allowed:
# permissive: no obligation beyond keeping the notice; safe to ship inside a proprietary image
MIT
MIT-0
BSD-2-Clause
BSD-3-Clause
0BSD
ISC
Apache-2.0
Zlib
Unlicense
CC0-1.0
BlueOak-1.0.0
PSF-2.0
Python-2.0
HPND
MIT-CMU
ZPL-2.1
CC-BY-4.0
# weak copyleft: obligations attach only to modifications of the library itself. Allowed because we use these as
# unmodified dependencies; patching or vendoring one needs a new review.
MPL-2.0
MPL-1.1
LGPL-2.0
LGPL-2.1
LGPL-3.0
# NOT allowed without an exception (strong copyleft or non-open): GPL-*, AGPL-*, SSPL-1.0, BUSL-1.1, CC-BY-NC-*, Commons Clause,
# proprietary, and any package whose licence cannot be determined ("UNKNOWN").
